summary: Telefônica Brasil S.A. filed a Form 6-K attaching the terms of its 2nd Incentive Plan via Performance Units with Cash Settlement, approved by the Board on June 12, 2024, and amended on February 20, 2025, and May 7, 2026. The plan grants participants units tied to the value of common shares (VIVT3), with cash settlement based on achievement of strategic objectives over three independent three-year cycles starting January 1, 2024. The plan is intended to align manager interests with shareholder value creation and retention. This is a standard compensation plan filing; no acquisition, divestiture, or other special situation is involved.
